recognize_zh: 視野中幾乎全是小至中型的淋巴球，圓核、染色質粗塊、細胞質呈窄邊淡藍，部分細胞較大、核染色質較細並可見小核仁（前淋巴球），下方有一個破碎的塗抹細胞，符合 CLL 伴前淋巴球。
features: Monotonous population of small to medium lymphocytes with round nuclei and clumped chromatin
Scant rim of pale-blue cytoplasm in most cells
Subset of larger cells with less condensed chromatin and occasional small nucleoli (prolymphocytes)
Smudge (basket) cell at the bottom and a ruptured cell at the lower right
Platelet clumps scattered in the background
describe_en: The smear shows a monotonous population of small to medium lymphocytes with round nuclei, coarse clumped chromatin, and scant pale-blue cytoplasm. A proportion of larger cells shows less condensed chromatin and small nucleoli, consistent with prolymphocytes, and smudge cells are present. Scattered platelet clumps are noted. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with increased prolymphocytes.

ddx.vs: Leukemic mantle cell lymphoma shows more irregular nuclei and a CD5+/CD23-negative, cyclin D1-positive phenotype, unlike CD23-positive CLL.
B-PLL is dominated (>55%) by medium cells with a single prominent nucleolus and is CD23-negative and FMC7/CD20-bright, whereas here small clumped-chromatin cells predominate.
Splenic marginal zone lymphoma cells often have polar villous projections and are usually CD5- and CD23-negative.
